mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering investor concerns about weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the risk of corporate profit deterioration and triggers negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 100 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 315.0 in a single month signals rising inflation pressures, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher real interest rates, which depress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.0 in a single month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 720,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS remains below 720,000 million dollars for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 accompanied by a decline in GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months indicates a severe economic contraction, which increases the likelihood of recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 declines for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 decline over 6 months fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).
